items.title: Photorealistic Portrait with Ukiyo-e and Industrial Fusion
items.prompt: Model the image after the attached image of a woman. A profile portrait. Left-facing profile with a cool, intelligent expression. Bust-up composition. The woman's face and skin must maintain completely photorealistic photographic quality. This is the highest priority, ensuring no illustration or anime style. Ultra-high-definition texture where every pore, fine hair, eyelash, and the translucency of the ear cartilage is visible. The background and decorative elements are a fusion of urban, industrial, and Ukiyo-e (Japanese woodblock print). Grid lines and measurement lines run across the entire screen, but parts of the grid transform into the curves of Hokusai's waves. Straight design lines suddenly change into the swell of wave crests at a certain point. Numerical and scale notations are mixed with vertical Japanese text. The sharp geometric triangles and lines placed in the background are indigo blue, the same deep blue as Ukiyo-e aizuri (indigo printing). Woodblock print wave patterns and swirling motifs are visible through the interior of the triangles. Geometry and Ukiyo-e patterns coexist in a single frame. Miniature-sized people are working on the woman's face and contours. They are Edo-period Ukiyo-e carvers and printers, carving the woodblock with small chisels and printing on washi paper with baren. The Ukiyo-e artisans are wearing indigo kimonos. Small scaffolding and ladders are erected along the contours of the face. The outline of the woman's profile is, in some parts, a sharp digital vector line, and in other parts, an Ukiyo-e outline drawn with ink and brush. Two line drawing techniques intersect on one person's face. Ink splatters and droplets are scattered across the entire screen, with indigo ink splatters and vermilion splatters mixed in with black ink splatters. The grunge texture is a combination of concrete wall texture and washi paper fiber texture. Absolutely no characters, text, typography, Japanese strings, seals, stamps, hanko, or signatures are included in the image. Lighting features dramatic shadows with strong contrast. Hard light from the left side of the screen makes the profile contour stand out clearly with distinct light and shadow. Film grain. Ultra-high resolution. Sharp. Art poster style.
